info.name: BrandFlow API — Master Collection (Enterprise Edition)
info.description: Complete, production-grade API testing collection covering all 12 modules, authentication, RBAC, billing, post generation, frames, templates, and analytics.

request.description: Returns API server status, system uptime, and health timestamp.

item.name: 1. Auth & User Management
item.description: API endpoints for User Authentication, RBAC, SubAdmin Management, 2FA, and Profile.

request.description: Registers a new user and returns JWT access & refresh tokens.
Logs in user or admin, returns tokens and profile data.
Verifies Google OAuth ID token and creates or logs in the user.
Generates and emails a 15-minute secure password reset token.
Resets the password with a valid token.
Verifies TOTP token for 2FA-enabled accounts.
Rotates and provides a new access token.
Clears authentication cookies.
Returns profile details of the authenticated user.
Generates TOTP secret and QR code for authenticator apps.
Enables 2FA by verifying the 6-digit TOTP code.
Disables two-factor authentication on the active account.
Creates a new SubAdmin with granular RBAC permissions. (SuperAdmin only)
Fetches paginated list of subadmins with assigned permissions. (SuperAdmin only)
Audits entities created by subadmins across categories, festivals, templates, and frames. (SuperAdmin only)
Updates SubAdmin details and tab permissions. (SuperAdmin only)
Deletes a SubAdmin account. (SuperAdmin only)
Fetches paginated list of registered users. (Admin & SuperAdmin)
Activates or suspends a user account. (Admin & SuperAdmin)

item.name: 3. Business Categories
item.description: API endpoints for managing 35+ Master Business Categories.

request.description: Fetches paginated business categories.
Fetches a single business category by its UUID.
Creates a new master business category. Requires admin or categories tab permission.
Updates a business category name, slug, or description.
Deletes a business category by ID.

item.name: 4. Festival Calendar
item.description: API endpoints for managing 40+ Annual Festival Calendar Events & Banners.

request.description: Fetches festival events with optional date and search filters.
Fetches a single festival event by UUID.

request.description: Creates a festival event with optional cover banner. (Admin / Festivals tab)
Updates festival event details and cover banner.
Deletes a festival event and cleans up associated banner from Cloudinary.

item.name: 5. Master Templates
item.description: API endpoints for managing Graphic Base Templates & Template Categories.

request.description: Fetches template categories (e.g. Festival Celebrations, Daily Quotes, Offers).
Creates a new template category taxonomy item. (Admin / Templates tab)
Deletes a template category by ID.
Fetches paginated system templates with optional category, template category, or festival filters.
Fetches single template details by ID.

Deletes a graphic template and removes image from Cloudinary.

request.description: Saves a rendered post graphic and deducts subscription credit quota.
Immediately publishes the graphic post to connected social media channels.
Queues post for background BullMQ worker execution at scheduled timestamp.
Updates and re-uploads graphic for an existing post without deducting extra subscription quota.
Deletes a post record and deletes image from Cloudinary.
Global audit of all posts created across the system. (Admin only)
Aggregated volume breakdown of generated posts. (Admin only)

item.name: 8. Vault
item.description: API endpoints for User Graphic Vault & Saved Designs.

request.description: Fetches saved graphic designs in the user vault.
Fetches single vault graphic design details.
Updates metadata of a vault item.
Deletes a single item from the vault.
Deletes multiple vault items in a single transaction.

item.name: 9. Social Media Accounts
item.description: API endpoints for Meta/Instagram & LinkedIn OAuth integration, connection URLs, and account disconnection.

request.description: Fetches list of connected social accounts with token expiration status.
Generates Instagram Graph OAuth authorization URL.
Generates LinkedIn OAuth 2.0 authorization URL.
Handles Meta OAuth redirection and exchanges code for long-lived page access tokens.
Handles LinkedIn OAuth redirection and persists access tokens.
Disconnects and wipes credentials for a social platform (INSTAGRAM, LINKEDIN).

item.name: 10. Billing & Revenue
item.description: API endpoints for Subscription Plans, Razorpay, Stripe, Invoicing, and Admin Ledger.

request.description: Fetches active user plan tier, remaining credits, and quota breakdown.
Fetches paginated payment and billing transaction history for user.
Activates starter free plan with 5 complimentary post credits.
Initializes a dynamic Pro tier purchase order via Razorpay.
Verifies HMAC SHA256 signature and upgrades user to PRO with allocated post credits.
Creates a Stripe PaymentIntent for international credit card checkout.
Verifies Stripe payment intent and credits post quota.
Generates and downloads a branded PDF tax invoice.
Grants complimentary bonus post credits to a user. (Admin only)
Financial KPI summary, MRR, gateway distribution, and subscription breakdown. (Admin only)
Immutable financial transactions ledger. (Admin only)
Records an offline wire/cash transaction and allocates post quota. (Admin only)
Exports audit-compliant financial ledger CSV. (Admin only)

item.name: 12. Analytics & Reporting
item.description: API endpoints for Performance Overview, Trends, Platform Breakdown, and Top Templates.

request.description: Fetches total posts created, scheduled, published, and engagement KPIs.
Fetches day-by-day creation and publication volume trends.
Distribution of published posts across Instagram and LinkedIn.
Fetches the most popular graphic templates by post creation volume.
Seeds realistic mock post and analytics records for testing and charts.
